cases.source: Provide CRUD operations for customers and orders and allow users to list all orders belonging to a customer.
assumptions: The list_orders action returns a list of orders for a given customer ID.
The number of orders (2) is assumed based on typical test data; not specified in requirements.
ambiguities: The requirements do not specify the exact output format or whether the list includes only active orders or all orders.
No example of the expected order list structure or field names is provided.

cases.source: Each order belongs to exactly one customer and has a date and status.
ambiguities: contradicts case create_order_with_invalid_status
contradicts case create_order_with_invalid_status

cases.source: Each order belongs to exactly one customer and has a date and status.
assumptions: The update_order_status action exists and is available to users.
The action updates only the status field, not other fields like date or customer_id.
ambiguities: The requirements do not specify whether the status update is allowed for all statuses or only specific ones.
No example of valid or invalid status transitions is provided.

cases.source: Customers can have multiple orders. Each order belongs to exactly one customer and has a date and status.
assumptions: The delete_order action exists and marks the order as deleted or removes it.
ambiguities: The requirements do not specify whether deletion removes the order or just marks it as deleted.
No mention of cascading effects (e.g., on customer or product stock).

cases.source: Each order belongs to exactly one customer and has a date and status.
assumptions: An invalid status like 'invalid_status' will trigger an error.
The error class is assumed to be 'InvalidOrderStatusError'.
ambiguities: The requirements do not specify valid status values or error handling for invalid ones.
No mention of what constitutes a valid status (e.g., pending, completed, cancelled).
